accent.$description: Accent border/indicator color (Adobe accent blue). Used for selected-state borders like the tab underline. Fills the gap where S2A had no semantic accent — the blue previously only lived in button/icon-button component tokens.

inverse.$description: Text and icon color for content on always-light surfaces — surfaces that stay light regardless of page or section mode (e.g. active state pills, surface-default cards used in a dark context). Resolves to the same dark value in both Light and Dark modes. Counterpart to content/knockout, which is always white for always-dark surfaces.

on-inverse.$description: Text and icon color for content on always-light surfaces — surfaces that stay light regardless of page or section mode (e.g. active state pills, surface-default cards used in a dark context). Resolves to the same dark value in both Light and Dark modes. Counterpart to content/knockout, which is always white for always-dark surfaces.

on-inverse-subtle.$description: Text and icon color for content on always-light surfaces — surfaces that stay light regardless of page or section mode (e.g. active state pills, surface-default cards used in a dark context). Resolves to the same dark value in both Light and Dark modes. Counterpart to content/knockout, which is always white for always-dark surfaces.

inverse-subtle.$description: Background for surfaces that invert relative to the current page mode — dark in light mode, light in dark mode. Use for expanded or active states where the component flips to contrast against the page (e.g. ElasticCard expanded state). Zero blast radius — safe to evolve. Counterpart: surface/subtle for the resting state.

inverse.$description: Background for surfaces that invert relative to the current page mode — dark in light mode, light in dark mode. Use for expanded or active states where the component flips to contrast against the page (e.g. ElasticCard expanded state). Zero blast radius — safe to evolve. Counterpart: surface/subtle for the resting state.
